name: West Memphis Steel Corporation
old_description: West Memphis Steel is a full-line hot rolled service center located in West Memphis, AR. WMS is a leader in the region for carbon steel as well as first and second stage processed parts. WMS services Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Missouri and Tennessee with next day deliveries while also maintaining weekly shipments nationwide. The combination of holding a huge inventory with processing capabilities has made WMS one of the most respected and reliable service centers in the Southeast.
about:
West Memphis Steel Corporation operates from West Memphis, Arkansas, where it was founded in 1978. The company has been owned since 1988 by President and CEO Byron P. Besser, who entered the business as the nephew of co‑owner Louis Barg and later acquired the operation.

The firm functions as a full‑line hot‑rolled steel service center, maintaining a large inventory of carbon‑steel products — including plate, sheet, structural shapes, tubing, pipe, and expanded metal — while also providing first‑ and second‑stage processing. Its three Arkansas campuses (Headquarters/Thompson, 7th Street, and Highway 77) house equipment for precision sawing, shearing, brake pressing, flat‑bed laser and plasma cutting, tube laser cutting, robotic welding, drilling/tapping, and assembly and kitting.

West Memphis Steel serves customers across Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Missouri, and Tennessee with next‑day truck delivery, and ships nationwide on a weekly schedule. Its client base includes manufacturers and fabricators that require just‑in‑time processed steel, though the company does not publicly list specific industry sectors.

The company states its mission is to improve people’s lives and sustain a family‑style culture where entrepreneurial spirit thrives, aiming to deliver a customer‑service experience that exceeds expectations and enables customers to excel. It emphasizes lean‑manufacturing support through just‑in‑time processing and next‑day delivery to lower operating costs.
